title: Build a Node.js, Express.js, Mongoose and MongoDB Application
requirements: Node.js Express Server Setup & Middleware Pipeline (Helmet, CORS, JSON, Rate Limit, Error Handling)
Mongoose Schema & Model Architecture (Data Types, Field Validations, Indexes, Instance Methods)
MongoDB Connection Configuration with Mongoose strictQuery
RESTful API CRUD Controllers (find, text search, findById, create, update, delete)
JWT Authentication Middleware (protect, requireRole) and Secured Routes
implemented: Node.js and Express server initialization with security middleware (Helmet, CORS, rate limiting, JSON parser, and centralized error handling).
Mongoose ODM integration with typed schemas, field validators, default values, timestamps, and compound text indexing for MongoDB collections.
RESTful API CRUD endpoints for books, categories, plans, and user authentication with JWT security middleware and role-based access control.
Full end-to-end integration verified with the live Kitab Ghar React client on localhost.
